newsitem.title: USA: Cardiogenesis and Chiron in pact.
newsitem.headline: Cardiogenesis and Chiron in pact.

text.p: CardioGenesis Corp and Chiron Corp Tuesday said the two companies have entered into a research collaboration to focus on the development of methods to enhance transmyocardial revascularization (TMR) for treatment of myocardial ischemia.

The companies said the preclinical research program will take place at a major university medical research center. Chiron will provide its proprietary cardiovascular compounds to the university program. Both CardioGenesis' epicardial and endocardial approaches to TMR will be used in the studies including the company's Intraoperative Transmyocardial Revascularization System and Percutaneous Myocardial Revascularization System.
